Corollary
[Linear scalar-curvature upper bound for steady solitons] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0173, page-0174 1. ch20:20.24\group Derivative Applications

For a three-dimensional nonflat steady gradient Ricci soliton with $\Rm \ge 0$ which is $\kappa $-noncollapsed at all scales, there is $C<\infty $ such that \[ R(x)\le \frac C{1+d(x,p)}. \]
